title: RallyAI Metrics Line
description: ONE LINE of a metrics JSONL file. The file on disk is the truth; the WebSocket to the browser is a convenience that replays these same lines. Append-only — a training run must survive a browser refresh, a crashed tab, and a killed server, because none of them own the data.

kind.description: Line type. Readers must ignore kinds they do not recognise rather than failing — that keeps an old viewer working against a newer trainer.

run_id.description: Stable id for this training run; the JSONL filename should match.

timesteps.description: Total environment steps consumed so far.

reward.description: Episode return statistics over the window since the last line.

terms.description: Mean per-episode contribution of each reward term. This is the instrument for the integrate-over-an-episode check: after any reward edit, these must be re-read to confirm the intended balance. Keys match the reward config field names.

completion.description: Outcome breakdown over the window. Counts, not rates, so windows can be re-aggregated later.

rate.description: Finished clean / total episodes. The number the curriculum gates on.

ppo.description: Optimiser diagnostics. approx_kl is load-bearing: the trust-region guard reads it to refuse an update that would destroy a competent policy.

rejected.description: True when the KL guard rolled this update back.

early_stopped.description: True when kl_early_stop cut the epoch loop short rather than discarding the update.

n_minibatches.description: Minibatch steps actually applied. Persistently short of epochs * ceil(n/minibatch) means the learning rate is too high for the batch.

log_std.description: Per-dim exploration scale, live after any rollback. A dim sitting on its cap is exploration that never converges — foundation_01 finished with throttle, brake and handbrake pinned there.

throughput.description: Tracked metric, not a nicety — a regression in steps/s is a regression.

eval.description: Held-out evaluation. seeds must never overlap the training seed pool; this reports generalisation, not memorisation.

time_vs_optimal.description: Mean stage time / generator's theoretical minimum for that seed.

json_path.description: Full evaluation record stored beside the checkpoint, so any claim can be re-derived.

checkpoint.description: Hall of fame, not a single file.

has_normaliser.description: A policy restored without its observation normaliser is a different policy. This must be true.

worker.description: Worker lifecycle. A dead worker gets revived rather than taking the run down; that revival is recorded here.
